title: Dog Talent Tree
description: A mod that adds a talent tree and progression system for tamed dogs.
body:
![Dog Talent Tree](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/04aab56fdf89e5dc2b5c1071d9b376d0ba398629.jpeg)
Bring a whole new level of depth to your tamed wolves! **Dog Talent Tree** introduces a complete RPG-style progression system for your canine companions. No longer just simple pets, your dogs can now grow stronger, earn experience, and unlock unique abilities as they fight by your side.

### 🐾 Leveling & Experience System
- **Earn XP**: Your dog gains experience points for every mob it kills. The tougher the mob, the more XP your dog earns!
- **Level Up**: Watch your dog grow from a pup to a legendary warrior. Each level up increases their power and grants **1 Talent Point**.
- **Immersive Effects**: Celebrate your dog's growth with vanilla-style level-up sounds, particles, and chat notifications.

### 🌳 Dynamic Talent Tree
Access the custom **Talent Tree GUI** by looking at your dog and pressing **'J'** (default keybind). The menu features:
- **XP Progression**: Track your dog's current experience and level with a dedicated XP bar.
- **Health Monitoring**: View your dog's health (hearts) directly in the menu.
- **Node Connections**: A visual progression system where certain talents require others to be unlocked first.

### ✨ Current Talents (v1.0)
- **Health Boost**: Dramatically increases your dog's survivability by adding **+10 Max Health** (5 extra hearts!).
- **Master Scavenger (Looting)**: Your dog becomes a master at finding treasures. Adds **+2 Looting levels** to all kills made by your wolf.
- **Hell-Hound (Fire Resistance)**: Grants your dog complete **immunity to fire and lava damage**. Perfect for Nether explorations!

### 🛠️ How to Use
1. Tame a wolf as usual.
2. Let your wolf fight mobs to earn XP.
3. Once your wolf levels up, look at it and press **'J'** to open the Talent Tree.
4. Spend your Talent Points to customize your dog's build!
